name: Hammerfall
summary: Horde forces hold Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, where old losses and a hard-won freedom shape the outpost. Orcs and Forsaken defend it against Boulderfist ogres, Witherbark trolls, and the League of Arathor.

sections.title: A Legacy of Liberation
sections.body:
Beneath Hammerfall lie the ruins of an Alliance internment camp. After the Second War, the human Alliance built vast camps across Lordaeron for defeated orcs, and this was among the largest. Years later, Thrall and Orgrim Doomhammer struck at the camp to free its lethargic captives.

As they retreated, an Alliance knight charged and drove a lance through Doomhammer's backplate. The Warchief was mortally wounded. After the Third War, the new Horde reclaimed the ruins and named its outpost Hammerfall in his memory.

sections.title: A Foothold in the Highlands
sections.body: Hammerfall gives the Horde a foothold in Arathi. Its garrison faces aggressive Boulderfist ogres from Boulder'gor and Boulderfist Hall, as well as the native Witherbark trolls. Forsaken Defilers use the outpost to claim resources in the contested Arathi Basin. There they oppose the Alliance's League of Arathor.

faq.q: Why is this base called Hammerfall?
faq.answer: The base honors Orgrim Doomhammer, who was mortally wounded by an Alliance knight's lance while freeing orcs from the internment camp.

faq.q: What was Hammerfall before the Horde rebuilt it?
faq.answer: Before the Horde rebuilt it, the site held one of the largest Alliance of Lordaeron internment camps. It was built after the Second War to imprison captive orcs.

faq.q: Who leads the defense of Hammerfall right now?
aliases: who is in charge of hammerfall
faq.answer: Orc Drum Fel rules Hammerfall and directs its defense against the Boulderfist ogres and Witherbark forest trolls. Tallow, a Forsaken warrior at Tarren Mill, first sends recruits to attack the Boulderfist ogres of Boulder'gor.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken stationed here?
faq.answer: Forsaken Defilers operate from Hammerfall to secure supplies from the Arathi Basin. They oppose the Alliance's League of Arathor.

angles.text: For orcs, Hammerfall is hallowed ground. Orgrim Doomhammer gave his life here freeing captive clanmates and passing the mantle of Warchief to Thrall.
For the Horde, Hammerfall is its fortress in the central Arathi Highlands. Hostile ogres, forest trolls, and remnants of the Alliance surround it.
